scope: 83 reference records: principal organs, General Assembly main committees, ECOSOC functional and regional commissions, specialized agency groups, funds/programmes and other entities, ten human rights treaty bodies, the Human Rights Council, two human rights review mechanisms, seven UNFCCC constituted bodies and the Santiago technical-assistance network, the Peacebuilding Commission, Peacebuilding Fund and Committee on World Food Security. UNDRR is included among other entities. Coverage does not enumerate every subsidiary body, mandate, treaty procedure or programme; bodies, funds and mechanisms are distinct categories. SDG follow-up, voluntary national review, resident coordination and country cooperation frameworks are included as distinct reference mechanisms.
affiliation: Lucy has no UN affiliation, mandate or endorsement. Task suggestions and SDG mappings are Lucy editorial proposals, not UN instructions.
